title: OpenFrontiers: A Collection of Open Research Problems and a Benchmark for Scientific Rediscovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.37739v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in research-level problem solving, yet a comprehensive collection of such problems is still missing, and evaluating them on research-level problems remains challenging. We introduce OpenFrontiers, a cross-disciplinary resource that combines a structured corpus of open research problems with a retrospective benchmark of recently resolved problems in mathematics. The corpus records problem statements, context, progress, and other information for 12,151 problems. The benchmark contains 200 problems, 110 resolved in 2026 and 90 still open, each with a Lean~4 statement checked by automated probes and two independent reviews; a subset HQ-50 further filters based on quality score, etc. Our evaluation protocol grades formal proofs with two independent checkers in an isolated sandbox under closed-book, frozen-retrieval, and live-web conditions. translated_title: OpenFrontiers：开放研究问题集合与科学再发现基准
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）在研究级问题求解方面展现出越来越大的潜力，然而目前仍缺乏此类问题的全面集合，且在研究级问题上对模型进行评估仍具挑战性。我们提出了 OpenFrontiers，这是一个跨学科资源，将结构化的开放研究问题语料库与针对近期已解决数学问题的回溯性基准相结合。该语料库记录了 12,151 个问题的问题描述、背景、研究进展及其他信息。该基准包含 200 个问题，其中 110 个已于 2026 年解决，90 个仍未解决，每个问题均配有经自动化探测工具校验并通过两次独立评审的 Lean 4 形式化陈述；其子集 HQ-50 进一步依据质量评分等标准进行筛选。我们的评估协议在隔离沙箱环境中，于闭卷、冻结检索和联网实时检索三种条件下，使用两个独立检查器对形式化证明进行评分。我们在 HQ-50 子集上对七个 LLM 智能体进行了评估……
tldr: 提出 OpenFrontiers：一个包含 12,151 个开放研究问题的跨学科语料库，以及一个由 200 个经 Lean 4 形式化并严格审核的数学问题（含高质量子集 HQ-50）构成的基准，配合多条件沙箱评估协议，用于系统评估 LLM 的科学再发现与研究级问题求解能力。
en_tdlr: OpenFrontiers introduces a cross-disciplinary corpus of 12,151 open research problems together with a rigorously vetted benchmark of 200 Lean 4 formalized mathematics problems (with a high-quality HQ-50 subset) and a sandboxed multi-condition evaluation protocol to systematically assess LLMs' capacity for scientific rediscovery and research-level problem solving.
